notes.repair: Both archives use v5 namespaces without a version declaration, and #3526 comments the broker declaration. Replay supplies v5, restores that exact declaration, types #226 integer inputs, corrects a display color and removes #3526's invalid unused stochastic display variable.
notes.timing: #226 computes double EMA inside the 2h context and selects its last completed value per daily chart bar. #3526 selects the last completed 15m close and then calculates TSI in daily context. An independent recurrence uses the first non-missing EMA source, with no engine-specific SMA startup.
notes.fills: Order flips fill at the next observed official first base-candle opening price. Each market is funded independently with the declared 1,000 starting capital and explicit one-base-unit orders. Source charges 0.2% or 0.15% per fill. Results use historical zero-margin chart-broker behavior with no funding, quote spread or liquidation, and can exceed the model starting balance in losses.
